learnings.insight: The 'CI' required check is an if:always() aggregator job that needs:[test, orchestrator], so it does not appear/report until 'Lint, Typecheck, and Test' finishes. A first API read right after a push can show mergeable_state:blocked with 'Lint' in_progress and 'CI' entirely absent from check-runs -- this is mid-flight, NOT a missing/failing gate.
learnings.action: Do not declare blocked on a first read; poll /commits/{sha}/check-runs and /commits/{sha}/status until all three required contexts reach completed and the Vercel commit status settles, then re-read the PR's mergeable_state (it flips blocked->clean).
